summary.text: Amanda Ybanez is the Republican candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic incumbent Shirley Ann Templo.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as the daughter of a Filipino immigrant who grew up in public housing and has volunteered in her community.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Ybanez said in a Ballotpedia survey that she attended Catholic school and has volunteered in her community for about a decade.
She said she has advocated on cost of living, affordable housing, public safety, workforce rights, disaster response, the environment and local agriculture for over a decade.
Ybanez advanced from the August 8, 2026 Republican primary.
Her listed campaign messages were putting the Kalihi community first and organizing the community around issues that affect it, and she named cost of living as her policy passion.
